premises.text: A significant portion of customers do not maximize their spending potential at local businesses
premises.evidence_span: 15% of their customers, people like me, represent about 50% of their revenue

premises.text: Traditional loyalty programs are inconvenient for customers
premises.evidence_span: But that's a pain for me to manage as a customer. I hate carrying them around.

premises.text: Existing mobile loyalty solutions require too much effort from customers
premises.evidence_span: A bunch of apps that sort of allow me to engage in the store, but they all suffer the same problem.

premises.text: Customers want personalized loyalty rewards based on their spending habits and interests
premises.evidence_span: they don't factor in how much I spend, what I'm interested in, and who I am

premises.text: Cardify allows customers to earn rewards seamlessly through their existing payment methods
premises.evidence_span: I get points at these local places by simply swiping my credit card

premises.text: Businesses can engage customers with personalized offers and experiences
premises.evidence_span: they can give me the buy five, get one free, or get 20% off my bill

premises.text: Cardify provides businesses with real-time insights about their customers
premises.evidence_span: we show the business's real-time insights into how Cardify impacts their bottom line

premises.text: Cardify can recognize customers in real-time and provide data about them to businesses
premises.evidence_span: Cardify, in real time, will show Fig and Olive who is at their store right now

premises.text: Partnerships with media and restaurant platforms can expand Cardify's reach
premises.evidence_span: Cardify has a partnership with Citigrid Media and with Urban Spoon

value.text: Customers receive personalized rewards and businesses gain insights into customer behavior
value.evidence_span: custom-tailored towards you based on how much you spend, what you're interested in, and who you are

notes: Exclusions include mentions of fundraising, demo offers, and specific customer counts.
